name: My First Sorting Problem
title: A. My First Sorting Problem
legend:
You are given two integers x and y.

Output two integers: the minimum of x and y, followed by the maximum of x and y.
input_spec:
The first line contains a single integer t (1≤t≤100) — the number of test cases.

The only line of each test case contains two space-separated integers x and y (0≤x,y≤9).
output_spec: For each test case, output two integers: the minimum of x and y, followed by the maximum of x and y.
